topic: Nath Finanças lança canal de notícias sobre economia Mundo Negro Brasil
insights: Nath Finanças launched N3 Notícias, a news channel focused on economy, financial markets, and personal finance.
The channel aims to make complex financial topics accessible to a broader audience.
N3 Notícias has gained significant views, surpassing 5.9 million views shortly after its launch.

quotes.text: A N3 Notícias aborda mercado financeiro, finanças pessoais e políticas econômicas com linguagem acessível.

summary: Nath Finanças has expanded its reach by launching N3 Notícias, a dedicated news channel that simplifies financial topics for the public. The channel has quickly gained popularity, achieving over 5.9 million views, indicating a strong interest in accessible financial education.
